name: Gumbad Cafe
short_description: Scenic rooftop cafe overlooking the historic domes of Jama Masjid, serving Mughlai, Italian, and mocktails.
long_description: Gumbad Cafe offers an atmospheric open-air and glass-encased rooftop dining experience with unobstructed panoramic views of the Jama Masjid. Seating options include casual low couches and high-top terrace railings.

name: Pt. Gaya Prasad Shiv Charan Paranthe Wale
short_description: Legendary 150-year-old vegetarian dining institution in Paranthe Wali Gali serving deep-fried stuffed parathas.
long_description: Established in 1872, Pt. Gaya Prasad Shiv Charan is one of the foundational culinary landmarks of Gali Paranthe Wali in Chandni Chowk. The cozy indoor dining room features traditional heritage seating and wall portraits of visiting dignitaries. Every paratha is prepared fresh in pure clarified butter (desi ghee) on low flat cast-iron pans and served alongside an unlimited spread of spicy aloo-tamatar curry, sweet sitaphal (pumpkin mash), methi banana chutney, and mint dip.
address_line1: Shop No. 34, Gali Paranthe Wali, Chandni Chowk

name: Pt. Babu Ram Paranthe Wala
short_description: Historic eatery dating back to 1886 in Paranthe Wali Gali famed for papad, khurchan, and dry fruit parathas.
long_description: Pt. Babu Ram Paranthe Wala has maintained unyielding culinary traditions since 1886. Located at the crossroads of Gali Paranthe Wali, the shop offers indoor bench seating where guests watch artisans knead, stuff, and shallow-fry parathas in bubbling brass vats of pure ghee. Accompaniments include potato curry, sweet pumpkin vegetable, and tangy homemade fruit chutney.

long_description: Founded in 1910, Shiv Mishthan Bhandar is an iconic North Indian breakfast and confectionary parlor on Katra Bariyan Road. name: Old Famous Jalebi Wala
short_description: Historic corner eatery established in 1884 at Dariba Kalan junction renowned for giant desi ghee jalebis and rabri.
long_description: Established in 1884, Old Famous Jalebi Wala anchors the busy intersection where Dariba Kalan meets main Chandni Chowk road. It features a historic seated dining counter where guests observe jalebis being piped into boiling desi ghee over coal fires. In addition to its famous thick jalebis soaked in khandsari (unrefined sugar) syrup, the eatery serves hot savory samosas with spicy potato gravy and thick kulhad lassis.
address_line1: Shop No. 1795, Dariba Corner, opp. Bank of Maharashtra, Dariba Kalan, Chandni Chowk

name: Natraj Dahi Bhalla Corner
short_description: Pioneering chaat counter since 1940 near Sis Ganj Gurudwara serving Delhi's most celebrated Dahi Bhalla and Aloo Tikki.
long_description: Operating since 1940 next to Bhai Mati Das Chowk in Chandni Chowk, Natraj Dahi Bhalla Corner is a household name across India. It features a cozy ground-floor seated ordering counter where patrons savor just two legendary, perfectly executed specialties: ultra-soft lentil dahi bhallas soaked in creamy yogurt and sweet saunth, and crisp pan-fried aloo tikkis stuffed with spiced dal and drenched in tangy chutney.
address_line1: 1396, Main Road, beside Central Bank of India, Kucha Mahajani, Chandni Chowk
